name: GRAVEL_ROADS_MAXIMUM_80_KMH_YELLOW_TALL
legend: GRAVEL ROADS MAXIMUM 80 km/h / DRIVE TO THE ROAD CONDITIONS
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. W1-SA101 900 x 1050 (2015, 1:10), R100, 10 / 30 (edge 10 + border 20). GRAVEL ROADS 80 C baseline 185, 665 overall (115/G 665 S/120); MAXIMUM 100 E baseline 430, 695 (100/695/105); 80 in 100 E (180, from 175) + 50 + km/h 85 E lower case (320, to 175 from the right), baseline 605 — k, m, the oblique stroke and h placed as drawn (the oblique stroke as a parallelogram on the sheet's ink — the font's own stroke is shorter). Blue panel 775 x 225 (60/775/65) from y 755 (150 below the baseline) to 70 above the bottom, corners R25 measured (not stated): DRIVE TO THE 70 C white, baseline 850 (245 below), 535 overall (180/D 535 E/185); ROAD CONDITIONS 70 C white, baseline 955 (105 pitch, 95 from the bottom), 695 overall (100/R 695 S/105). Word gaps set to span the stated overall widths. The limit (80) is the sign's fixed legend. Approval required.
